header: Is this element on the screen right now? I return a ref, not state, so reading it never draws the page again; it is true while any part of the element is in the window. The three auto-scrolling lists of the home page read it in their frame loop and stand still while they are below the fold (nobody sees them move, and every frame of theirs was layout work). With `pauseOffscreenScrollers: false` in src/lib/perf/switches.js it is always true: the previous way.
